worldcombat.skill.crabhammer.summary: Raise the great pincer overhead, gather water on it, then bring it straight down: the target in front takes the heaviest single blow while the impact opens a ground wave that shoves other foes nearby. The cracking form also breaks the target's defence, at the cost of being slower and lighter; the heavy form simply hits harder.
worldcombat.skill.crabhammer.description: The pincer deals %1$s contact damage to the target in front, the heaviest blow of this move.
Reach is %1$s blocks; other foes within the %3$s block ground ring each take %2$s splash.
The struck target and the other foes the wave catches are both shoved about %1$s blocks; the wave pushes them away from the impact point.
worldcombat.skill.crabhammer.stance.crac: Cracking form: the hit drops the target's defence by 1 stage and widens the ring 1.1x; the cost is 0.94x slam power, +2 wind-up ticks and +6 cooldown ticks.
worldcombat.skill.crabhammer.stance.heav: Heavy form: 1.06x slam power, a smaller ring and a quicker wind-up; the cost is no armour break at all.
worldcombat.skill.crabhammer.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.crabhammer.growth.0: From level %1$s the slam rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.crabhammer.growth.1: From level %1$s the slam rises to %2$s and the ring widens to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.crabhammer.use.0: One overhead slam for the heaviest single hit
worldcombat.skill.crabhammer.use.1: Open a ground wave that shoves everyone nearby
worldcombat.skill.crabhammer.use.2: Break a target's defence in the cracking form
On: the hit drops the target's defence by 1 stage and widens the ring 1.1x, at 0.94x slam power, +2 wind-up ticks and +6 cooldown ticks. Off: the heavy form, 1.06x slam power, a smaller ring and a quicker wind-up, but no armour break.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of raising the pincer. Larger values open from further out, but the longer wind-up gives the target more time to step away.
On: targets 1.6 blocks tall or more are hit first, where the armour break and ground wave matter most. Off: it orders like an ordinary melee attack.
